### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone
Root: on-demand payout (user's own write). Its hub (on_demand_payout_request, "Ledger state the payout amount waits on") states three sentences:
- H1 "An on-demand payout is fixed only after the scheduled payout due on the same payout day stands on the payments ledger." Query: Daily Plus initiates "every business day" (payout_schedule_and_bank_arrival); 2026-10-15 is a Thursday; ledger has no scheduled `payout_disbursement` dated 2026-10-15; payable ≥ 1.00 minimum → a scheduled payout is due and not standing. Write found by the words "scheduled payout": scheduled_payout_sending ("sends the scheduled payout of the current payout day"). **state-derived**.
- H2 "An on-demand payout is not worked out until every chargeback case whose dispute is recorded as won carries its returned-debit entry on the payments ledger." Query: CB-20260908-2264 `dispute_status 'won'`, no reversal row. Write found by "returned-debit entry": won_chargeback_debit_return_posting ("books one chargeback reversal entry of the returned-debit kind"). Amount from won_chargeback_debit_return_amount + factors. **state-derived**.
- H3 "Before an on-demand payout amount is worked out, every instant payout already sent that day must carry its instant payout fee entry on the payments ledger." Query: IP-20261015-527 has no fee row. Write found by "instant payout fee entry": instant_payout_fee_posting. **state-derived**.
- No further hop: the three depended-on hubs state no waited-on state of their own. Order: {H3, H2, H1} (any order among them; the scheduled amount is limit-bound here) → root.

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only the on-demand payout of 45325.05": excluded by H1–H3 (the amount is not fixed/worked out until those states stand) and by the holdback factor rules, which keep back amounts from the on-demand payable.
- Closest alternatives: instant payout instead — persona declines; plan cap 250000.00 vs scaled limit — scheduled_payout_amount scopes the limit to scheduled payouts and new_bank/standing/age/FBN docs read "scheduled payout"; on-demand cap stays the plan maximum. Fee return on CB-20260908-2264: evidence share 0 (plan does not return, refund-already-issued) → nothing to book; not a hop of the on-demand hub anyway. Lost case CB-20260804-1187 excluded by "lost, books nothing further". Reserve of afec5592 not due.
- Fall-back numbers (definite and different): instant fee 72.00 vs 41.04; debit return 1150.00 vs 1147.00; scheduled 46431.01-type whole payable vs 33000.00; on-demand 13431.01 vs 7607.96.
